verdict.rationale: Brex's docs and marketing show a genuine consolidated platform (spend, budgets, bill pay/AP automation, banking with cash back) fitting the story (brex-docs-6/7/8/10), but extensive founder/community accounts describe abrupt account closures, exclusionary onboarding requiring VC backing or large cash minimums, and business pivots away from small/startup customers (brex-comm-13,14,15,16,9,10), undermining reliability of this platform for many founders.
